text:
maya_eng: Heads up - Tom posted new lead times for H100 batch. Sea ~45d, air ~6d. They only have limited air slots and propose: partial air expedite + vendor credit for DOAs + loaner pool. Need quick decision on air top-up vs credit for EU edge pools.

 tom_vendor: We can air up to 20 units at +$10k/unit or provide loaners up to 30 units at $200/day/unit. DOA coverage: 30% credit + depot repair SLA (7 business days). Can split AWBs by region.

 raj_procure: Cost math please: air 10 vs air 20 for EU and any brokerage/insurance add-ons. Also describe credit timing.

 tom_vendor: Air10 = +$100k, Air20 = +$200k. Brokerage billed separately; we will waive brokerage if PO amendment signed today. Credit memo issued within 10 business days after photo & serial evidence; applied to next invoice. Cash refunds take ~30 days.

 elaine_ops: Ops ask: Depot capacity FRA/AMS? Can swaps happen within 48h of arrival? We need pre-generated RMA labels and manifest format. Also confirm HS code differences for air vs sea.

 ops-bot: Ticket INF-VEND-4521 created and assigned to elaine_ops (EU air top-up + RMA label flow).

 maya_eng: Preference: minimize cash. Approve air up to 10 units for critical EU pools if brokerage waived and vendor can turn serial CSV in 48h. Rest on credit + loaners.

 tom_vendor: We can waive brokerage with signed PO amendment today. RMA labels: we will pre-generate. Need serial CSV within 48h to bind AWBs. Sample manifest schema accepted.

 raj_procure: Locking plan: air 10 with amendment + waiver. Rest: credit + loaners until replacements ship. Confirm loaner pickup/drop policy and daily cap.

 elaine_ops: Ops will reserve FRA-DEPOT-3 and AMS-POOL-1 slots and pre-authorize swap labels. We'll require photo evidence and a QC checklist on receipt.

 tom_vendor: Amendment and waiver PDF to be sent EOD. AWB splits: EU-air (10 units) AWB EU-AT-75819; rest sea LCL AWB SEA-LCL-99822. Photos uploaded to RMA portal.

 ops-bot: INF-VEND-4521 updated: depot slots reserved FRA-DEPOT-3 (up to 12 swaps) and AMS-POOL-1 (loaners up to 30). ETA window for air arrival approx 1761420000-1761423600.

 raj_procure: Will review amendment. If vendor delays, fallback = credit + extend loaner window.

 elaine_ops: What's DOA detection window? We need at least 7 days.

 tom_vendor: DOA window is 14 calendar days from receipt for full credit. We'll add clause in amendment.

 maya_eng: Action items: 1) Tom send PO amendment + waiver + AWB details. 2) Ops prepare serial CSV + depot manifest. 3) Procure sign amendment and confirm payment terms. I'll monitor INF-VEND-4521.

 elaine_ops: Will prep manifest and QC checklist.

 raj_procure: Pinging finance once amendment arrives.

 tom_vendor: Amendment sent via portal and email. Please confirm receipt.

 maya_eng: Received. Tagging INF-VEND-4521 watchers. Thanks team.
